statements.impact_statement: REEVALUATE (touched): merged commit 2f05d38 touched curriculum-controller.ts. Re-verified — the code path is unchanged in substance: `res.send(result)` on line 532 still receives the return of EditLeaseService.release/releaseAll (edit-lease-service.ts:82-91): `{released: boolean}` (from `count > 0`) or `{released: number}` (a Prisma updateMany count). Neither payload contains user-supplied strings, and res.send auto-detects the object argument and serialises as JSON with Content-Type application/json — a browser cannot render it as HTML. Two independent defences still hold; original not_affected disposition re-confirmed with a fresh 90-day window.
